value.rationale: The closed-form sharp three-state local-attractor wedge is a natural finite-patch ecological stability classification. It separates invasion failure and patterned coexistence and isolates a universal b/d=9/4 change in the role of habitat bias. Valid for all positive b,d; gives an exact rational realization while respecting nonlinear/global limitations.
